title: Tiny, cute rain cloud
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cloudGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfe8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fb8e8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='dropGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='0%' y2='100%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f9fe0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- cloud puffs -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='14' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='17' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='14' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='40' width='52' height='16' rx='8' fill='url(#cloudGrad)'/>
  <!-- cloud highlights -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='26' r='7' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='4' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <!-- rain drops -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='86' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='3' ry='4.5' fill='url(#dropGrad)'/>
  <!-- little face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#2a3550'/>
  <path d='M45 51 q5 4 10 0' stroke='#2a3550' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffb3c7' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffb3c7' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
